title: One Player Tools
description: This datapack makes it so only one type of tool or armor can exist between all players.
body:
## **⚔️ One Person Tools (OPT)**
The ultimate "sharing is caring" nightmare.

Ever felt like Minecraft was too easy with everyone having their own gear? One Person Tools introduces a competitive twist where only one instance of a specific item can exist across the entire server.

This datapack is perfect for speedrunning to make it chaotic or regular survival to annoy your friends.

## **🕹️ How It Works**
If you craft a Diamond Pickaxe, you are the exclusive holder. The moment another player crafts or picks up a Diamond Pickaxe, yours instantly vanishes from your inventory, and they become the new holder.

Whether you’re speedrunning or just trying to survive, you’ll have to move fast or play dirty to keep your gear!

## **✨ Key Features**
- Works across all players. Only one person gets the tool at a time.

- Don't want to fight over the same item? Use the in-game menu to enable or disable specific items.

- Keep the chaos quiet or announce every theft with customizable chat notifications.

- Lightweight and designed to work with Minecraft 1.21.11.

## **⚙️ Quick Start**
Default Menu Key: Press G

From the menu, you can toggle item categories (Tools, Armor, Weapons) and manage notification settings.

## **🛠️ Installation Guide**
Download the OPT.zip file.

Navigate to your Minecraft world folder and drop the zip into the datapacks folder.

Important: Ensure you are at the Main Menu or have the world closed when applying the pack to ensure the Menu works correctly.

Launch the world and have fun!

## **📝 Compatibility**
Version: 1.21.11

_Multiplayer: Highly recommended! (Technically works in Singleplayer, but you'll just be fighting your own shadow)._
